body:
I implemented the staged replacement design in PR #53: https://github.com/gmkurtzer/ginux/pull/53

The loader now builds ELF, heap, and stack pages directly in their final replacement frames, prepares a replacement page-table hierarchy off-line, retains vvar/vDSO and any old frames still referenced by another process, and switches roots only after preparation succeeds. It does not add a payload copy; the cost is temporary old-plus-new peak memory until commit.

Local deterministic evidence passed: make check and the complete make test QEMU sequence, including the shared hierarchy primitive forced pre-commit rollback. I also attempted make test-rocky-shell, but the guest rejected every OCI DNS response and exhausted all three pull attempts before unpack or exec. I left the HDAE gate and PR open pending that rootfs-specific integration run. I have not merged the PR or closed this issue.
